title: How to use Cursor AI to 10x your coding speed

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Cursor AI doesn't just speed up coding — it rewrites how we think about productivity through protocol-driven automation. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But "how" is irrelevant if you don't know "to" — the real power comes from knowing exactly what to build, not just how to build it. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: With built-in protocol templates and auto-generated API docs, Cursor AI gives you the "how" to execute any "to" with precision and speed. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without a clear "to," even the fastest "how" is just noise — you need direction, not just velocity. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Code without purpose is just lines on a screen — Cursor AI needs a "to" to matter. (4 sec)
